## GD·08 Morning call list (Boss 5 · D6b)
Every day 7:30: "call first" = ready contacts (harvest_score ≥ 65) with no call logged; "going cold" = open deals with no activity for 7 days. One Telegram message to Tolu.

**Credentials:** HubSpot App Token, Telegram. **Replace:** YOUR_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID.
